abrigarse: to shelter oneself; to keep warm
acreditaros: to prove to you; to show you (pl.)
actitud: aptitude, fitness (here: readiness to exercise rights)
advertirlo: to notice it; to point it out
alejarme: to move away; to go farther
aprovechó: took advantage of; made use of
asegurarme: to assure myself; to make sure
atribuirse: to claim for oneself; to attribute to oneself
boca: mouth; "boca de" at the mouth of
cargaban: they were charging; they were loading
cargo: "a cargo de" in the charge of
condénsense: let them be condensed; let them gather
consecuente: "más consecuente" most far-reaching in its consequences
contrario: contrary; "por el contrario" on the contrary
debí: I had to; I ought to have
descenderé: I shall descend; I shall stoop
descolgarse: to come down; to let oneself down
desembocar: to debouch; to emerge (from a defile)
disputarnos: to dispute with us; to contest against us
díganlo: let them say it; let it be said by
enfín: in short; finally (as printed, for en fin)
entremeteré: I shall meddle; I shall go into
envolverlos: to envelop them; to surround them
escarmentar: to punish exemplarily, to teach a lesson
exponerlo: to expose it; to set it out
falta: lack; «por falta de»: for want of
fines: ends; (a fines de) at the end of
flor: a flor de agua: at water level
gentes: peoples; derecho de gentes: law of nations
hacen: make; «hacen por cuatro años»: it is four years
haceros: to make yourselves; to make you (pl.)
hotentotes: Hottentots (as printed; used as a byword for the uncouth)
ignorar: to be unaware of; to ignore
ilustrísima: Most Illustrious (f.; title of a prelate)
interpelo: I call upon; I appeal to
mareó: Marcó (surname; as the text layer reads it)
pasarlos: to run them through; to pass them
prado: Prado (cuesta del Prado, place name); meadow
rato: while (por largo rato: for a long while)
representándole: pointing out to him; representing to him
separarlo: to separate him; to remove him
sistemar: to systematise; to put in order
tiro: shot; range (a tiro de fusil: within musket range)
tártaro: Tartar; Tártaro (San Andrés del Tártaro, place)
verificaré: I shall carry out; I shall do
